title: How to Make Your Car Disappear Underground
mission: Make an ORIGINAL animation in the same broad visual language as the uploaded toilet-engineering reference, matching lighting, camera grammar, model fidelity, subtitles, cadence and narrative structure rather than literally reusing its footage or characters.

reference_traits.render_look: Clean lightly stylized 3D, lightly beveled edges, credible diffuse contact shadows, modest realism, avoid flat sprites and unlit primitives.
reference_traits.setting: Warm cream plaster wall, oak trim and planks, earth-brown cutaway with visible pebbles, desaturated gray concrete, softly lit green lawn.
reference_traits.lighting: soft warm daylight, large diffuse key area light, ambient fill, gentle AO; no cinematic neon, no harsh high-contrast dramatic lighting.
reference_traits.palette: Pale oak, cream/off-white, gray block wall, brown soil, translucent blue mechanical overlays and water, restrained red warnings.
reference_traits.camera: 3/4 orthographic-ish cutaway or 35mm medium shots, no handheld jitter, smooth easing, same persistent geometry frame to frame.
reference_traits.subtitles: Bold white sans-serif with black outline, two-three-word rhythm, centered in lower-middle safe title area.
reference_traits.narrator: Conversational direct second-person; lively, lightly humorous, 170-185 wpm overall; original voice, no attempt to clone actual voice.
reference_traits.vfx: Transparent blue construction guides, fluid flow visualization, particles for rain and dust, small visual celebration on final shot.
reference_traits.editing: Frequent visual reveal/problem/solution cadence; every 2-5 sec a meaningful visible object change.

quality_gate: Render S02 and S06 as still frame comparisons with source before any other rendering.
Do not substitute unrelated AI-generated shots for the 3D master scene.
At 100 percent size there must be modeled edges, bevels, joints, texture grain, contact shadows and sensible water movement.
All mechanics must visibly connect and obey hierarchy.
Every new shot must preserve the car identity and chamber location.
Render in vertical 1080x1920; no captions obscuring operating parts.
Listen to narration first, then retime visual keyframes to stressed verbs.
Treat it as fictional visualization, not instructions for a real underground vehicle lift.

scene_list.name: The vanishing car hook
scene_list.spoken: What if your car could vanish underground?
scene_list.visual: A small silver hatchback sits on a simple paved driveway in front of a cream-plaster house. Ground slab lowers 30 cm with car aboard; camera holds as grass and paving obscure the edges. Preview final payoff immediately.
scene_list.camera: Medium-wide, 3/4 perspective, camera at 1.35 m, 35 mm equivalent, slow 6 cm dolly forward
scene_list.animation: Car settles slightly on platform. Ground/driveway slabs vertically lower with mechanical easing. No vehicle movement on wheels.
scene_list.subtitle_style: Reference: bold white center-bottom, thick black outline, max 2 lines, text changes every 2-4 words; important mechanism remains visible.

scene_list.name: Cutaway excavation
scene_list.spoken: You start by digging a hole beneath your driveway.
scene_list.visual: Cutaway ground beneath driveway. The underground volume is initially glowing translucent blue; rectangular soil volume disappears in a clean construction reveal.
scene_list.camera: Locked 3/4 cutaway at eye line just above grade, orthographic scale preserving same house geometry
scene_list.animation: Ghosted blue construction box extrudes downward; soil visually slides or dissolves away in chunks.
scene_list.subtitle_style: Reference: bold white center-bottom, thick black outline, max 2 lines, text changes every 2-4 words; important mechanism remains visible.

scene_list.name: First design fails
scene_list.spoken: But the dirt collapses, and your car nearly falls in. You need stronger walls.
scene_list.visual: Soil visibly cracks and a small section crumbles into excavation. Car jolts on the top slab before stopping; a translucent red warning silhouette flashes.
scene_list.camera: Tight cutaway, moderate pan 12 degrees to show unstable right-hand wall
scene_list.animation: A few clods crumble; platform jolts by 4 cm, then pauses (never fully falls).
scene_list.subtitle_style: Reference: bold white center-bottom, thick black outline, max 2 lines, text changes every 2-4 words; important mechanism remains visible.

scene_list.name: Reinforced chamber
scene_list.spoken: So you add reinforced concrete walls, steel beams, and a solid platform above.
scene_list.visual: Gray concrete walls and footing pour into place around the pit; reinforcing steel appears first, then concrete opacity rises. Four short beams form supports for the platform.
scene_list.camera: Same 3/4 ground cutaway; subtle smooth move downward to emphasize steel and geometry
scene_list.animation: Steel rebar grows into place, gray concrete panels appear in sequence, top platform slides into place.
scene_list.subtitle_style: Reference: bold white center-bottom, thick black outline, max 2 lines, text changes every 2-4 words; important mechanism remains visible.

scene_list.name: Lifting problem
scene_list.spoken: But how do you lift a whole car?
scene_list.visual: A two-dimensional yellow force arrow appears beneath suspended platform while car is above, showing the missing mechanism.
scene_list.subtitle_style: Reference: bold white center-bottom, thick black outline, max 2 lines, text changes every 2-4 words; important mechanism remains visible.

scene_list.name: Hydraulics explained
scene_list.spoken: Install hydraulic cylinders. A pump pushes oil through the pipes, lifting the platform and the car together.
scene_list.visual: Two steel hydraulic pistons appear and connect to cylinders. Transparent blue oil paths show fluid flow. Platform smoothly lifts from bottom to surface, silver car remaining stable.
scene_list.camera: Two beats: 3/4 close-up of cylinders 19.85–22.85, wide cutaway to show full lift 22.85–26.75
scene_list.animation: Rod extends along Y; connected platform rises without wobble; blue fluid flows within translucent pipeline.
scene_list.subtitle_style: Reference: bold white center-bottom, thick black outline, max 2 lines, text changes every 2-4 words; important mechanism remains visible.

scene_list.name: Rainwater failure
scene_list.spoken: Perfect. Until the first rainstorm turns your hidden garage into a swimming pool.
scene_list.visual: Warm daylight changes to stormy gray; rain hits open driveway crack; water leaks down the underground wall and gathers around lower car tires.
scene_list.camera: Start exterior, transition 1.5s to cross-section of underground cavity
scene_list.animation: Rain lines fall vertically; stylized translucent blue fill rises from floor and ripples.
scene_list.subtitle_style: Reference: bold white center-bottom, thick black outline, max 2 lines, text changes every 2-4 words; important mechanism remains visible.

scene_list.name: Drainage and pump
scene_list.spoken: Add a floor drain, a sump pump, and a one-way valve.
scene_list.visual: A drain appears under the car; water channels into a small sump; pump moves glowing blue water through a white pipe; flap of a check valve closes after flow.
scene_list.camera: Close-up of drainage at floor and pipe inside soil, matching toilet reference cutaway style
scene_list.animation: Water flows into sump, through white pipe; blue valve element moves as flow changes.
scene_list.subtitle_style: Reference: bold white center-bottom, thick black outline, max 2 lines, text changes every 2-4 words; important mechanism remains visible.

scene_list.name: Dangerous pinch point
scene_list.spoken: Except now someone could get trapped by the moving platform.
scene_list.visual: Simple wooden crate near platform edge is highlighted in red as platform moves. Avoid human injury depiction.
scene_list.camera: Medium close-up on platform guide rail
scene_list.animation: Platform begins lowering, then freezes before contacting crate.
scene_list.subtitle_style: Reference: bold white center-bottom, thick black outline, max 2 lines, text changes every 2-4 words; important mechanism remains visible.

scene_list.name: Add safety sensors
scene_list.spoken: Sensors can stop the lift whenever something enters its path.
scene_list.visual: Two small black sensors mounted either side of platform send thin glowing amber beams; wooden crate interrupts beam; platform halts.
scene_list.camera: Close-up of sensor position and barrier beam, then pull back to see stopped platform
scene_list.animation: Amber beam appears, crate crosses it, red stop indicator pulses; platform halts.
scene_list.subtitle_style: Reference: bold white center-bottom, thick black outline, max 2 lines, text changes every 2-4 words; important mechanism remains visible.

scene_list.name: Hide the mechanism
scene_list.spoken: Finally, cover the lift with paving that perfectly matches your driveway.
scene_list.visual: Small surface paver tiles slide together on lift platform. Hydraulic cylinders retract. Slab becomes nearly invisible among driveway tiles.
scene_list.camera: Smooth dolly from underground cutaway to exterior wide composition
scene_list.animation: Paver tiles settle, slab lowers 0.5 m, glides up flush with neighboring driveway; seam becomes hidden by alignment.
scene_list.subtitle_style: Reference: bold white center-bottom, thick black outline, max 2 lines, text changes every 2-4 words; important mechanism remains visible.

scene_list.name: Secret garage final payoff
scene_list.spoken: One button. And your entire garage disappears.
scene_list.visual: Clear wide 3/4 cutaway of the completed silver car parked in chamber beneath spotless driveway. Lift rises and lowers once in a satisfying final demonstration; sparkle/confetti at reveal.
scene_list.camera: Fixed master wide cutaway, same model coordinates as S04
scene_list.animation: One 70 cm lift cycle with eased keyframes; overlay x-ray reveal of chamber through ground.
scene_list.subtitle_style: Reference: bold white center-bottom, thick black outline, max 2 lines, text changes every 2-4 words; important mechanism remains visible.
